name: GreenThumb Site Visits
description:
This dataset records site visits and inspections of community gardens, with 361 sampled rows and 35 columns. Each row represents one inspection of a garden, identified by a park ID (parksid) and an inspection ID (inspectionid). The data captures physical characteristics of each site, such as total fence length, sidewalk area and length, and whether the garden is next to another garden. It also records infrastructure and amenities, including on-site service, nearby fire hydrants, rain harvesting and gallons collected, solar panels, compost systems and tumblers, sheds, park signs, murals, ponds, and greenhouses.

A large set of yes/no fields describes what the garden contains or supports: food and non-food plants, open lawn or communal areas, paved areas, trees (including fruit trees, street trees, and empty tree pits), chickens, turtles, fish in ponds, aquaponics, farmers markets, CSA pickups, and composting.
